Description.value:
This patch let this A19(?) mod https://www.nexusmods.com/7daystodie/mods/569 work again. You will have a tactical advantage by knowing where the enemies are.
IMPORTANT, you need to manually fix the mod: 1) ModInfo.xml: 1.1) remove the open and close tags: ModInfo 1.2) edit the mod 'Name value=' tag to remove the space as 'MilitaryTablet' 1.3) create tag 'DisplayName value=' with 'Military Tablet' 1.4) create tag 'Version value=' with '2.5.1.0' (2.5 is the game version, 2.0 the mod version) 2) You need to disable/delete original mod entityclasses.xml. 3) an updated tablet.unity3d may be found here: https://dev.azure.com/KhaineUK/_git/Darkness%20Falls%20V6?path=/Mods/0-DarknessFallsCore/Assets/tablet.unity3d
Tip(linux): use this geany edit format command to prettify original xml files: xmlindent -i 2 -f
